visualBrief: Vienna’s historic State Hall on Josefsplatz, with ivory Baroque pilasters, arched divided windows, three doors, gilded globes and the central sculptural roof group.

references.role: Library identity and the historic State Hall
Josefsplatz elevation, pale pilasters, dark roof and sculpted parapet
Portal arches, pane grids, capitals and proportions of the gilt globes
Façade and roof composition from Josefsplatz

limitations: Exterior reconstruction of the historic State Hall wing on Josefsplatz. The adjoining imperial wings belong to the Hofburg Palace model, and other library locations stay with the native map.
Exterior figures, reliefs and the gilded globes are reconstructed from photographs. The interior library, oval ceiling fresco and collections are outside this exterior model.
Street height follows standard Terrarium elevation. Exact thresholds and the roof and ornaments are interpreted at World Viewer scale.
